title: Fun with Fibonacci
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: Nesting the Fibonacci function k times starting from n gives a value the task must report modulo p, for up to a hundred thousand independent queries. Both n and k reach a quintillion while the modulus p stays at or below one million, so the nested value is astronomically large and only its residue can ever be formed.
